description: Find ASINs similar to a given ASIN by brand, price band, and seller count. Use when the user asks 'ASINs like this one', 'similar products', 'comparable ASINs', 'what else is like B08N5WRWNW', or any ASIN-level lookalike question. Each comparable carries product brand, title, price (or price range) and fulfillment (FBA/FBM/AMZ + amz/fba pct).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_seller_count.description: Only comparables with at least this many distinct sellers.

name: asin_comparables
